## What it is

The base, four levels for a 1 m strip, three spacers, and the cap, in place on the deck. `extra_levels` adds whole levels above that.

## Design notes

- 15 of the 16 molded clips land on a 1 m strip. The last clip of the fourth level is past the strip. It is still printed so the high cross stays a full part.
- Level to level is one 23 mm pitch. The four clips inside a level step 5.75 mm, a quarter pitch.
- This assembly is not exported as its own STL. Export the parts.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't reuse the old count of eight loose clips. That was a different coil and a different part.
